reviews.text: Good care for your pet, you can walk around and come back refreshed. Excellent care for rabbits and cats when you have to be away from home. Longer care periods are also possible, for example during renovations.

This is a quality vacation for the cat. We have been taking our beloved cat for several years. The good thing is that you don't have to worry about how the cat is doing on vacation. This is where they take care of it and provide information on how the vacation with the cat goes. The owner of the place is absolutely wonderful with a love for the species. We warmly recommend this place.

At this cat shelter, each cat is treated as an individual. It's clear that the owner knows the soul of the cat.
Both of our cats are very happy, even though they have completely opposite personalities (timid and bold).
Once you take your pet here for treatment, you'll hardly want to try anyone else.

Masha was in care for 3 days during my move. She was picked up from home and then I picked her up and got to know the care center at the same time. The facilities are really cute and Tiina the cat grandma has decorated the rooms with the cutest cat items and textiles. The cat studio was a suitable space for Masha, because she is more timid and likes to rest and safely watch the activities of others from behind a glass wall. I warmly recommend Tiina's care center.
Lovely, gentle and friendly caretakers who really like animals. The place is clean and warm, and the prices are reasonable.
You can bring your kittens here and go on a trip without worrying, the mother cat will take care of them.

Full five stars. The care is done with the cats in mind, the owner is very knowledgeable about the typical behavior of cats. I happily left my cat here for the trip and the cats had a great time! We will definitely come again. Thank you ❤️
